fields.short_description: Understand the ecosystem before you begin.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Vitanaland is your new digital world for health and personal growth. It's the platform where I, your assistant Vitana, live.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Here you have your safe space to work on your goals at your own pace. You're never alone, because your MAXINA community is here too.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You come to Vitanaland whenever you need support in your daily life or want to connect with others.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap Continue now to see how you can call me anytime through the ORB.

fields.short_description: Understand the ecosystem before you begin.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The MAXINA community is your personal network within Vitanaland. This is where people come together who want to grow alongside each other.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You're never alone on your journey and you benefit from others' experiences. This gives you a sense of belonging and fresh motivation every day.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Visit this area when you want to connect with others, join events, or simply gather some inspiration.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on the community overview now and take your time looking around.

fields.short_description: Get to know your assistant and voice control.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: I'm Vitana, your personal assistant. You can reach me through the ORB – that's the small sphere in the bottom right corner of your screen.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: With me, you hardly need to type anything anymore. Just talk to me, and I'll remember everything important for you.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: When you want to quickly log a glass of water you just drank, for example, just tell me.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on the ORB now and see how easy it is.

fields.short_description: Get to know your assistant and voice control.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The ORB is the small sphere in the bottom right corner of your screen. When you tap it, you can talk to me right away.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You save yourself the hassle of typing. Just tell me what you need, and I'll log it for you.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Tap the ORB when you want to quickly record your first glass of water after waking up, without typing.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on the ORB now and just say a quick hello to me.

fields.short_description: 90 sessions, free navigation, and exercises explained simply.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: "My journey" is your guided path through Vitanaland, divided into 90 short lessons. You can jump between topics, but you'll always practice what you've learned in real life to truly master it.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't need a perfect plan to live healthier. These small, daily steps help you build new habits in a relaxed way.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check "My journey" every morning to find your next lesson or task for the day.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen to jump right into your journey and look around.

fields.short_description: 90 sessions, free navigation, and exercises explained simply.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: My journey consists of 90 short stations that show you around Vitanaland. You can simply jump to new topics or unlock stations directly by trying things out.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This gives you complete freedom to learn at your own pace. You only focus on what actually helps you in your daily life.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Open the overview whenever you're curious about the next step.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on My journey and discover your upcoming stations.

fields.short_description: Set up your personal goal system.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The life compass is your most important goal for the next 90 days. It sets the direction I'll guide you toward.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This allows me to tailor all suggestions exactly to your personal wish. You'll only receive tips that truly bring you closer to your big goal.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Choose a goal in the life compass when you want to focus entirely on your health or your career, for example.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and open the life compass to take a closer look.

fields.short_description: Set up your personal goal system.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The life compass is your most important goal for the next 90 days. It tells me exactly the direction we want to go together.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way I adapt all tips precisely to your current wishes. Every small step then helps you achieve exactly that dream.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You set it whenever you want to focus on a new area in your life, like your health or your career.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and choose the first direction for your life compass.

fields.short_description: Get to know the Vitana Index early on.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your Vitana Index grows with every healthy choice you make in daily life. Whether you drink a glass of water or go for a walk, the number adjusts right away.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you immediately see which small habits benefit you the most personally. It shows you in black and white what truly does your body good.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check your index to see how even a short walk or a glass of water improves your number.
fields.explanation_try_this: Open your Vitana Index now and discover which small action can boost it right away.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your health in Vitanaland always rests on five pillars: sleep, movement, nutrition, mental strength, and hydration. Together they form your Vitana Index.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This makes the goal of living healthier wonderfully simple and measurable for you. You can see at a glance where you're already strong and where you can still balance things out.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this overview daily to check whether your different life areas are well balanced.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap Continue now to take a closer look at your five pillars on the next screen.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your weakest pillar is the area among the five pillars that currently needs the most attention. I identify this automatically for you every day.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you don't have to do everything perfectly all at once. When you strengthen this one area specifically, your Vitana Index rises the fastest.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check your weakest pillar in the morning to set your focus for the day in a relaxed way.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to find out which of your pillars is your weakest one today.

fields.short_description: The promise of better quality of life.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The Life Compass is your most important goal for the next ninety days. It helps me guide your quality of life in exactly the right direction.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: From now on, all my tips adapt to this one wish. This way we're not just collecting data—we're noticeably improving your life.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You use the compass whenever you want to shift your focus in life to something new for a while.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to discover your own Life Compass and choose your first goal.

fields.short_description: The promise of better quality of life.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The Life Compass is your most important goal for the next 90 days. When you put your health at the center here, everything aligns with that.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You won't get random tips—instead you'll receive tailored suggestions for more sleep and movement. This way every small step brings you noticeably closer to a healthier life.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You choose this focus when you want to give your body your full attention again after a demanding time.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and point your Life Compass toward health.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The privacy section gives you full control over your personal information in Vitanaland. Here you alone decide which data stays private and which can be shared.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This gives you complete peace of mind, because nothing ever happens without your explicit permission. You can use Vitana in a totally relaxed way without any worries.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check this section when you want to specify exactly which information Autopilot can use to find suitable offers for you.
fields.explanation_try_this: Open the privacy settings now and see how easy it is to control everything.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: So I can support you properly, I save important details in your memories. But you always decide entirely on your own what I'm allowed to remember.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This gives me the ability to make truly fitting suggestions for My Journey in your daily life. At the same time, you always keep absolute control over your data.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You use this feature whenever I should add a new detail about you to the Memory Garden.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to try out for yourself how you give me permission to remember.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your profile is your personal home in the MAXINA community. Here you simply show who you are and what interests you.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: A completed profile helps me find the perfect people and opportunities for you. It makes you visible so others can support you.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Fill out your profile before you ask me to search for matching contacts or new opportunities for you.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap your profile and add your first interest right away.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your profile is your calling card in the MAXINA community. It shows others who you are and what you're good at.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: A well-filled profile instantly builds trust with others. It helps you find the right people and great new opportunities.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You update your profile whenever you want to make new connections or become more visible in the community.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap your profile now and add a new piece of information to build trust in the community.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The ORB is the small round sphere at the bottom right of your screen. When you tap it, I listen to you and answer your questions.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't have to type anything laboriously anymore—you can simply talk to me naturally. This saves you time and makes your daily life easier.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use the ORB, for example, when you're on the go and want to quickly add something to your journal.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the ORB and ask me your first question right away.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: With the ORB you can easily navigate through Vitanaland using your voice. Just tell me where you want to go, and I'll open the right page for you.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't have to memorize menus or search for a long time. This saves you time and makes using the app incredibly easy.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this when you want to quickly open your journal or your Life Compass without searching on the screen.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the ORB right now and tell me to open the Life Compass to try it out.

fields.short_description: This is what your daily start looks like.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The daily rhythm is your simple routine here in Vitanaland. It consists of small, doable steps that connect your health with concrete actions for the day.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't need a perfect plan to live healthier. This simple routine helps you take care of yourself every day without any stress.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this routine in the morning with your coffee to start your day, and in the evening to briefly capture your experiences in your journal.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to try out your first daily rhythm.

fields.short_description: This is what your daily start looks like.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: During your first 30 days, I'll guide you with small daily tips on your home screen. It's like a guided tour through the app.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you discover a new, useful feature every day without feeling overwhelmed. The discovery tour adapts to your own pace in a relaxed way.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Simply check your home screen every morning to discover your short tip for the day.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the button to jump right into your first little exercise and try it out yourself.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Sleep is one of the five pillars in Vitana and forms the foundation of your recovery. It's a central building block for keeping your Vitana Index in balance.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: A good overview of your sleep shows you whether you're really recovering enough. This way you can adjust small things to start your day with much more energy.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You check this section when you wake up in the morning and want to understand why you're full of energy or still feeling tired.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the sleep section now to take a closer look at this important pillar.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Sleep is one of the five pillars and the most important time for your recovery. Here you enter how long and how well you slept during the night.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: When you record your sleep, you understand exactly how your night's rest affects your day. This helps you plan your energy better.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: It's best to enter your sleep in your journal every morning right after waking up.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and enter your sleep from last night to try it out.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Hydration is one of the five pillars for your health. It simply shows you whether your body is getting enough water every day.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Enough water gives you more energy right away and helps you stay more alert. It's the easiest way to strengthen your body and your Vitana Index.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check this pillar when you get tired in the afternoon and need a quick energy boost.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap continue to explore your hydration section now.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Here you enter how much water you've had. It's a simple way to keep track of your hydration.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you see right away whether your body has enough water. It's a quick win for your daily routine.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it, for example, right after getting up when you drink your first glass of water.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the button and enter your first water now.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Movement is one of the five pillars in your life compass. It shows you how active you are each day.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Regular activity is like an engine that gives you fresh energy. It helps you feel more alert and stronger in your daily life.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Think of this pillar when you take a refreshing walk after sitting at your desk for a long time.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the movement area now and see where you can find your activities.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: This is where you log how you moved today. It could be a walk, a workout, or even some housework.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you quickly see how movement gives you fresh energy. Every step counts and strengthens your well-being.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this feature right after a short walk or in a relaxed moment in the evening.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the button and log your first movement now.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Nutrition is one of the five pillars for your health. Here you easily keep track of what you eat.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you see how your meals affect your Vitana Index. It helps you understand your body better without any stress.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check your nutrition pillar when you want to know if you've eaten well and balanced today.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and open your nutrition pillar.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: A meal note is a simple way to record your food in your journal. You don't need to count calories—just briefly describe your dish.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you keep track of your nutrition in a relaxed way without stressing yourself. It's a simple way to keep an eye on one of the most important of the five pillars.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: It's best to make a quick note right after lunch while the memory is still fresh.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and create your very first meal note.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Mental strength is one of the five pillars for your well-being. It includes everything that's good for your mind, like relaxation, focus, or beautiful moments.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you see how well you're taking care of your inner balance. You'll notice right away when you should take more time for yourself.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check this area when your daily life is particularly stressful and you're looking for ways to find inner calm.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen to take a closer look at your mental strength area.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The one-minute reset is a short, guided break for your mind. It's a simple exercise for your mental strength.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: It helps you quickly release everyday stress and refocus. This gives you an instant boost of fresh energy.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it when everything feels a bit too much or when you just want to take a quick breath between appointments.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the button for the one-minute reset and try this soothing relaxation right now.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The journal is your place for quick notes throughout the day. Here you can log everything that matters for your health and the five pillars.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: It makes your progress visible and helps you live more mindfully. The more you share, the better I learn how to support you in just the right way.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it in the evening to reflect on your day, or in between to note a glass of water or how you're feeling.
fields.explanation_try_this: Open the journal now and write your first short entry for today.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The voice journal is the easiest way to capture your experiences. Just tap the microphone and speak instead of typing.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This saves you a lot of time and feels completely natural. I understand your words right away and automatically use them for your Vitana Index.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it right after exercising or during a short break to quickly tell me what you just did.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the little microphone now and record your very first entry.

fields.short_description: Stay on track and follow through.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Reminders are little nudges throughout your day. They help you not forget your planned tasks.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you don't have to remember everything yourself and stay relaxed on track. It frees up your mind and helps you stick with it.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use them when you want to drink a glass of water every afternoon or write a quick journal entry in the evening, for example.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to open the reminders area and get to know it.

fields.short_description: Stay on track and follow through.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: With a reminder, you set me up to remind you of your plans at the right time. This way nothing gets lost in your busy day.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This makes it much easier for you to stick to your good intentions. Your mind is free because I take care of remembering for you.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Create a reminder when you plan to drink a glass of water tonight but worry you might forget in the hustle and bustle.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and set your very first reminder.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The calendar is your personal planner in Vitanaland. Here your healthy intentions get a fixed spot.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Good intentions become habits more easily when they have a set time. This way you put your plans into action in a relaxed and reliable way.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Add an appointment when you're thinking in the morning about when you'll have time for a walk today, for example.
fields.explanation_try_this: Open the calendar now and reserve some time for your first healthy intention.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: This is a small window that opens right over your current screen. Here you turn a good intention into a planned action.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You won't lose your train of thought because you don't have to leave your current screen. This way you put your goals into action immediately and without detours.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it when you want to schedule something important for later in the day without interrupting your current task.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and plan a small, quick action for today.

fields.short_description: You choose how deep you go.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Autopilot is your personal guide that suggests fitting tasks for you each day. It waits as a little airplane icon for your decisions.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You decide entirely on your own which paths you take and how deep you want to dive. This way you only commit to what truly feels right for you today.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it in the morning to calmly choose the best steps for your day and find your own pace.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the airplane icon now and discover your first paths for today.

fields.short_description: You choose how deep you go.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Autopilot is your personal, smart task list that you access via the airplane icon. It suggests concrete steps, but you choose what you actually want to do.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This takes daily planning off your hands and shows you exactly what will strengthen your Vitana Index the most today. You always stay in full control because nothing happens without your okay.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: It's best to use it first thing in the morning to pick the right actions for your day and get going.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the little airplane icon now to see your first suggestions and start your day.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your daily flow is a simple cycle of discovering, taking action, and logging in your journal. This way you build a healthy routine step by step.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't need a perfect plan to live healthier. This small cycle helps you see doable progress every day without stress.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Start this simple flow every morning to head into your day relaxed and with a clear goal.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen to open your overview for today and try out the flow.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Autopilot is your intelligent companion for the day. It automatically suggests the next small task that fits you perfectly right now.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't have to come up with a perfect health plan. I take that work off your hands and simply show you the best next step.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use Autopilot whenever you have a short break and want to do something good for your health.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on Autopilot and see what action I've prepared for you today.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: This is where you decide how to handle your daily tasks. You can complete them right away or simply postpone them.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This takes the pressure off having to be perfect every single day. I learn from your choices which rhythm works best for you.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this feature when you're planning your day and deciding what's doable right now.
fields.explanation_try_this: Now pick a task and decide whether you want to complete it or postpone it.

fields.short_description: Home is your daily command center.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The home screen is your daily command center in the app. Right after logging in, you'll see all the important updates and shortcuts here.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: It saves you valuable time because the most important information is visible right away. You can see at a glance what's a priority today and how your Vitana Index is doing.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Open the home screen every morning like a good newspaper to quickly check in on your day.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap through your home screen now and see what's new today.

fields.short_description: Home is your daily command center.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The home screen is your command center for every day. Here you'll find all your important tasks, reminders, and recommendations at a glance.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You save time and immediately see what's coming up next. This helps you work toward your goals without much effort or stress.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: It's best to check your home screen first thing every morning to plan your day.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and explore your personal home screen.

fields.short_description: Home is your daily command center.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The AI feed is a special section on your home screen. Here you'll find personal insights generated specifically for you.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Instead of generic news, you get tips that match your life compass perfectly. This way you instantly know which small change will benefit you most today.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check your AI feed in the morning with your first coffee to find your personal focus for the day.
fields.explanation_try_this: Open the AI feed now and rate your first post so I can get to know you even better.

fields.short_description: This is how your index becomes actionable.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Index drivers are the concrete everyday actions that change your Vitana Index. These include things like a glass of water, a walk, or a good night's sleep.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: They show you exactly which small changes truly benefit your body. This way you learn which simple steps boost your well-being the most.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use them whenever you're thinking about which small action would make the biggest positive difference for you today.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and discover which actions move your Vitana Index the most.

fields.short_description: This is how your index becomes actionable.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The Vitana Index is made up of scores for your five pillars: sleep, movement, nutrition, mental strength, and hydration. These individual scores show you exactly how your overall score is composed.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you can see at a glance where you're already on track and which area still needs attention. It makes it really easy to make the right decision for your day.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check your scores in the morning, for example, to see whether you should focus on your water intake or more movement today.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the detail view now to explore the individual scores of your five pillars.

fields.short_description: This is how your index becomes actionable.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Every day you can deliberately choose an action that will improve your Vitana Index the most. This action is your personal driver.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Instead of trying to change everything at once, you focus on one single, impactful task. This saves energy and moves you forward right away.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: It's best to do this right after waking up to set a clear goal for your day.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and choose your very first driver for today.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The sleep trend shows you clearly and simply how your recovery develops over time. It belongs to the sleep area, one of the five pillars of your health.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You instantly recognize patterns in your nights and see if you might be missing important rest. This helps you enormously in keeping your Vitana Index balanced.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Take a quick look in the morning to better understand why you feel more energized or more tired than usual today.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now and discover your own sleep trend.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The sleep plan is your personal roadmap to a restful night. It belongs to the sleep pillar and helps you wind down better in the evening.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You wake up with more energy in the morning and feel noticeably fresher. This strengthens your Vitana Index in a targeted way.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Take a quick look at it in the evening before you get ready for bed.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to discover your own sleep plan.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your bedtime reminder is a gentle nudge in the evening. It helps you wind down in time.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you never miss the perfect moment to go to sleep. Your body can recover better and you start the new day feeling fresher.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: This reminder is ideal in the evening when you want to wrap up the day relaxed and prepare for a restful night.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to set up and try out your first bedtime reminder.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The hydration pillar shows you how well you're drinking throughout the day. You can easily log your drinks in the journal or connect a tracker.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you immediately see if your body is getting enough water to stay fit. It helps you keep your Vitana Index balanced.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: It's best to log your drinks right after waking up or with every meal.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen and log your first glass of water right now.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your nutrition is one of the five pillars that make up your Vitana Index. This is where all the data from your connected trackers and your journal comes together.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you can easily see if your body is getting the right energy for the day. It helps you make healthier choices without much effort.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Take a quick look at this pillar in the evening when you want to check how balanced your day was.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the nutrition pillar now to connect your daily trackers.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: In the journal you can log your daily movement or connect your fitness trackers directly. This way you collect all your activities in one secure place.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: When I know how you move, I can give you tips that fit your everyday life better. This strengthens you and improves your personal Vitana Index.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: It's best to use this feature right after a walk or in the evening to record your daily activities.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the journal now and add your movement for today.

fields.short_description: Connect inner calm with good decisions.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The mental well-being pattern shows you how your inner calm affects your daily life. It's a valuable part of your mental pillar.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You clearly see how a relaxed mind helps you make healthier decisions. This gives you more control over your well-being.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Look at this pattern when you've had a restless day and want to understand what's disrupting your balance.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen and discover your own mental patterns now.

fields.short_description: Connect inner calm with good decisions.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: This is where you record your breathing exercises or meditations. It's a simple place for your moments of calm.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: When you're relaxed inside, you make much clearer decisions. This builds your mental strength a little more each day.

fields.short_description: Connect inner calm with good decisions.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: This feature shows you how stress affects your day. You'll see how inner calm helps you make clearer decisions.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: When you understand your stress better, you can take a break in time. This gives you more composure and energy for everyday life.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this after a hectic event to take a breath and get a clear head again.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to discover your first insights about stress.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Here you'll find valuable knowledge about the five pillars of your health. This section shows you your current status and your Vitana Index in an easy-to-understand way.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you learn at your own pace without feeling overwhelmed. It helps you make small, good decisions for your wellbeing every day.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check this section when you want to learn something new about your body or mind in peace.
fields.explanation_try_this: Simply tap the button to explore your new health learning area for yourself.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: This section shows you your health data and possible risks in a clear overview. It also makes clear when professional medical help is needed.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you learn to understand your body better without feeling overwhelmed. You also always know exactly which questions require a real doctor.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check here when you want to review your health status or find out whether a real medical concern is present.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to learn about your current health information and our safety limits.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Vitana is your companion for a healthy everyday life, but not a medical expert. For serious illnesses, diagnoses, or pain, I'll point out this boundary to you.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This protects your health and gives you a sense of security. You know exactly what you can rely on me for and when advice from a real doctor is needed.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: When you ask me through the ORB about certain symptoms or treatments, I'll gently remind you to see an expert.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to see an example of this important boundary in practice.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The biomarker preview is a small window that opens right over your current screen. It shows you a compact overview of your health data.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you can check new values safely and immediately continue where you left off. It helps you understand your body even better.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You use this view when you want to quickly check details about the five pillars of your health during your day.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the preview to safely view your biomarkers now.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Here you can link your smartwatch, calendar, or other health apps with Vitana. This is the central and secure place for all external connections.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way important data for your five pillars is captured automatically, without you having to type anything. It helps me tailor my tips even better to your daily life.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use these settings when you want to automatically transfer your daily steps from your fitness tracker, for example.
fields.explanation_try_this: Take a look at the list of available apps and tap one to connect it.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: You can easily connect your health apps and trackers with Vitana at a later time. This way you always keep full control over which data you want to share.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't have to share everything right away to use Vitana. This way you decide completely relaxed, at your own pace, when you want deeper insights into your health.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Exactly when you feel ready to securely add precise measurements from your smartwatch or other apps.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the button to calmly see how you can connect data securely later.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Health plans are your personal guide. Here we turn your health goals into simple, clear steps.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you're never overwhelmed—you always know exactly what you can do for yourself today. It makes it easy to live a little healthier every day.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check here every morning to get a small, doable task for the day.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to open your very first health plan and look at it in peace.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The Service Hub is your central starting point for everything health-related. Here you see your current status and choose your next step.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: It helps you turn your health goals into a simple plan. This way you easily strengthen the five pillars of your wellbeing.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it when you want to do something good for yourself and are looking for a specific activity or professional support.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap continue to open the Service Hub and find your first step.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: A plan step is a small, doable task for your health. It helps you easily incorporate the five pillars into your daily life.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Big goals often feel hard, but small steps you can manage effortlessly. This way you improve your wellbeing a little more each day, without stress.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Create a plan step when you want to do something good for yourself, like drinking one more glass of water today or going for a walk in the evening.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the button to create your very first plan step and try it out right away.

fields.short_description: Get to know the entire memory system.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your memories are the place where everything I learn about you is collected. It's your personal overview where all important details are kept safe.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This makes me feel like a real assistant who truly knows and understands you. Plus, you always have full control here over what I remember.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Open this overview when you want to check whether I remembered your latest plan correctly.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to open your memories and look around in peace.

fields.short_description: Get to know the entire memory system.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your memories are Vitana's secure memory. Here I store everything you tell me through the ORB or record in your journal.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you only have to tell me important things once. I get to know you better each day and can help you in a more tailored way.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check here when you want to review which preferences, health goals, or details I've already remembered about you.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen to see right away what Vitana already knows about you.

fields.short_description: Get to know the entire memory system.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your memories aren't just a chat history—they're neatly organized into different areas of life. These include categories like health, relationships, work, or finances.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you always have a clear overview of all the important details from your life. Plus, I can give you much more relevant answers.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Browse the categories when you want to specifically check which tips you've saved for your fitness or an important project.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the categories on your screen now to get to know the system.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The memory garden is the heart of my memory. Here I store everything you tell me or safely entrust to me.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way we don't have to start from scratch every time. I remember important details for you so your mind stays nice and clear.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Add a memory when you want to capture a valuable thought, a new plan, or a great recommendation.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen and add your very first memory now.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The timeline is like a personal history book in your memory garden. Here you can see all your past experiences and notes clearly organized in one place.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you easily keep track of your important milestones. At the same time, you help me understand you and your needs better and better.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Stop by here when you're looking for a specific experience from the past or simply want to browse through beautiful moments.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on the timeline and discover how your collected moments are lined up there.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Vitana doesn't just remember facts—it can also retrieve them for you in a flash. You can search specifically for things you told me at some point.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you have to remember less and can free up your mind for more important things. Whether it's a book recommendation or a name, I'll find the information for you again.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it when you want to remember a specific restaurant, for example, that a friend recommended months ago.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on search and let's retrieve an old piece of information together.

fields.short_description: Stay in control of your memory.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: You have full control over your memories in the app. When something changes in your life, you can easily correct the entries.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This keeps Vitana always up to date about you. That way you always get the best and most fitting answers.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this, for example, when you have a new sleep goal or Vitana remembered an incorrect detail.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the button and try out right away how to correct an entry.

fields.short_description: Stay in control of your memory.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: In your memory garden permissions, you define exactly what I'm allowed to know and use. It's your personal control center for your data.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you always stay in full control of your privacy. You alone decide which information should help me support you better in everyday life.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this when you want to specify that certain personal topics should be completely ignored by me.
fields.explanation_try_this: Take a look at your permissions now and adjust them to whatever makes you feel most comfortable.

fields.short_description: Stay in control of your memory.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: With data export, you can download everything Vitana has learned about you. It's a simple tool to back up your own data on your device.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you always have the certainty that your memories truly belong to you. You can save a private copy of your collected data anytime.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this feature when you want to create your own backup of all your notes and experiences for safety.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on the screen to start a data export and see how easy it is.

fields.short_description: Your journal is more than writing.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: A daily entry in your journal builds an ongoing streak. It's not just a notebook—it's the engine for your personal progress.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: The more regularly you use it, the better I learn your habits. Your biggest reward is always more tailored recommendations for you.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Take a short moment every evening for an entry to keep your streak going.
fields.explanation_try_this: Open your journal and start your very first streak today.

fields.short_description: Your journal is more than writing.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The photo journal is your visual memory album in Vitanaland. Here you can easily save pictures of your experiences alongside your texts.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Pictures often capture more feelings and details than words alone. This makes your entries more vivid and lets you look back on your journey even more beautifully later.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it when you've cooked a great healthy meal or want to capture a beautiful walk in nature.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the camera icon now and upload your first photo to your journal.

fields.short_description: Your journal is more than writing.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your journal is more than just a place for your notes. Every entry there directly strengthens your five pillars.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Your small wins become visible right away and flow into your Vitana Index. Plus, this helps me learn to give you exactly the tips you need right now.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: After eating, briefly note how healthy your meal was to fill up your nutrition pillar right away.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on your journal now and briefly capture how you're feeling today.

fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you always stay calm and keep track of your time. It gives you a secure feeling for the whole day.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Best open your calendar agenda first thing in the morning to get relaxed and ready for your day.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on the calendar now to open and explore today's overview.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Here you can add new appointments to your calendar. This helps you schedule your tasks and activities firmly in Vitanaland.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you won't forget important meetups from the MAXINA community or times for your five pillars. Your day gets a clear and relaxed structure.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Create an appointment when you want to block a fixed time for a new habit or an event.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on the screen now to create your first appointment right away.

fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you stay wonderfully flexible and stress-free. Your everyday life adapts to you, not the other way around.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this when something comes up and you simply want to move your planned workout or a meetup to later.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on the appointment on the screen now and select a new time.

fields.short_description: Get to know your inbox and communication.

fields.explanation_when_to_use: Stop by here to see if someone from the MAXINA community has written to you or if a new reminder is waiting.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your inbox has different tabs to separate active messages from things already done or archived. This way you always keep track of all incoming items.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This protects you from chaos and ensures no important reminder gets lost. You can focus entirely on what's happening right now.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use these sections when you're looking for older information or want to tidy up your current inbox.

fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this area when you're looking for new ideas or simply want to see what others are up to.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on the community area now and look around the MAXINA community.

fields.explanation_user_benefit: When you write down your experiences, you sort out your own thoughts. At the same time, you receive wonderful support from like-minded people on your journey.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Write a post when you want to celebrate a small success or need some advice.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap on the text field now to draft your very first post.

fields.explanation_user_benefit: On your way through My Journey, you're never alone. When you respond safely to others, you gather new motivation while supporting others at the same time.

fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen to view your personal link and try it out right away.

fields.short_description: Get to know Sell and Earn.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: This is a clear overview of your earnings and commissions. Here you can see exactly what you've earned through your referrals and sales.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You always keep your successes in sight while going through My Journey. This motivates you and shows you right away how your efforts are paying off.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this view when you want to see how much you've already earned this month.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the overview to discover your current commissions now.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Here you decide where your achievements and posts get published. This can be the MAXINA community or a specific group.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You reach exactly the people who motivate you on your journey. You always stay in full control of who sees your progress.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this setting when you've reached a special milestone on your journey and want to celebrate it with like-minded people.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the selection now to see the different channels and set your favorites.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Here you decide where your posts and achievements become visible. You can choose between the MAXINA community and other social networks.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Shared successes are twice as motivating. When you share your progress with like-minded people, it gives you valuable support.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this setting as soon as you've reached a milestone and want to proudly celebrate it with others.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the channels and choose where you want to publish your next success.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Here you write and edit the texts you want to share with others. You can compose your own messages or customize Vitana's ready-made drafts for your achievements.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You save a lot of time because you only have to write your text once to share it everywhere. At the same time, you always stay in full control of every word.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it when you've reached a goal and want to quickly personalize your post before it goes live.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the text field and write your very first test post now.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Here you can see exactly how your shared posts and actions are performing. It's a simple overview of the key numbers for your current campaign.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you immediately recognize what really resonates with your audience. It helps you keep improving your future content.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check these numbers when you want to know how many people you've reached after a new action.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the numbers on the screen and try out this overview right away.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Here you can see exactly how many people your campaign has reached and who clicks on it. It's your simple overview for the success of your posts.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you immediately recognize what resonates well with the MAXINA community. You can easily improve your content and inspire even more people.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Take a look at these numbers when you want to check how well your latest post is doing after a few days.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap one of your campaigns now to take a closer look at the current clicks and reactions.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Here you can give a single campaign the finishing touch. You simply adjust which content gets shared.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you make sure your message reaches the right people. You always stay in full control of your data.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this feature when you want to tweak a draft a little before sharing it with others.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap a campaign and try out right away how you can improve it.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Here you find exactly the right customers for your offer. I help you discover suitable people in the MAXINA community and contact them safely.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This saves you the tedious search and makes it easy to build a real network. You directly reach the people you can truly help.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this feature when you're ready for new orders and looking for your next dream customer.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap customer management now and let's search together for your first matching contact.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The calendar is your personal planner in Vitanaland. Here you organize your appointments, tasks, and health goals in a clear overview.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way your mind stays free and you won't miss any important plans. You can structure your daily life in a relaxed way and reach your goals much more easily.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use the calendar when you're planning your day in the morning or want to reserve time for your five pillars.
fields.explanation_try_this: Open the calendar now and enter your first small task for today right away.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The delivery checklist helps you keep track of your orders. It's a simple step-by-step guide for working with your customers.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you won't forget any important details and always offer reliable service. It saves you time and gives you complete peace of mind.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use it whenever you've won a new customer and want to deliver your service smoothly.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen to open your first delivery checklist for a customer.

fields.short_description: Get to know earnings and payouts.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Here you'll find your personal overview of all earnings and payouts in Vitanaland. It shows you simply and clearly how your daily actions are rewarded.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you see directly that your healthy routine is paying off for you. It motivates you to stay on track with your goals every day.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check here after a successful day to enjoy your earned rewards.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the earnings and payouts section to discover your first rewards.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Here you can see the status of your collected rewards from your daily tasks. It shows you exactly what's still pending or already available, and gives you a look back at your history.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You'll see right away that your active steps in Vitanaland literally pay off. This motivates you to keep going and continue nurturing your habits.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check here when you want to know if the reward for your last journal entry is already available.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the overview on the screen now and explore your collected rewards.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Payout readiness shows you whether your collected earnings have been released. It marks the moment when your rewards are ready to be claimed.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You'll know immediately when you can use your earnings. This gives you peace of mind and rewards your daily routine.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You check here as soon as you want to withdraw your collected earnings from Vitanaland.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the display to check your current payout readiness right away.

fields.short_description: Get to know the Marketplace Autopilot.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The Marketplace Autopilot automatically searches for offers and products that match you. It connects your health goals with helpful services in Vitanaland.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You save yourself long searches because only things that truly match your interests are suggested to you. This way you easily discover new paths for your health or even for your own income.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: It's perfect when you want to discover new ideas, products, or career opportunities without having to search through everything yourself.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to get to know and try out your Marketplace Autopilot.

fields.short_description: Get to know the Marketplace Autopilot.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The Autopilot shows you matching opportunities for how you can improve your health or even build an income in Vitanaland. It suggests things that fit exactly with your current goals.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't have to search for matching offers or business opportunities yourself. The Autopilot brings the best opportunities directly to you so you can grow both health-wise and professionally.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Check out the suggestions when you're ready for the next step on your journey and want to discover new offers or connections.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the current suggestions and discover what new opportunities are waiting for you today.

fields.short_description: Get to know the Marketplace Autopilot.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The Autopilot suggests matching offers to you. It shows you exactly why something fits you and always asks for your permission.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you always keep full control over your data. You only see opportunities that are truly useful for you.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You pay attention to this when you receive a new recommendation and want to understand why it's good for you.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the example now and see why it was selected for you.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Vitana shows you offers and opportunities that match you perfectly. We always explain transparently why we're recommending something to you.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You always keep full control over your decisions. This way you can discover new things safely and with complete peace of mind.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You see these recommendations whenever the Autopilot has a helpful idea for your health or your income.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the next card and see how a safe recommendation is structured.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: In our MAXINA community, we place great value on honesty in all offers. This means we strictly avoid false promises or exaggerated claims.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This keeps Vitanaland a safe and trustworthy place for all of us. You build genuine trust when you offer services or recommendations.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Keep this principle in mind whenever you create your own offer or share a product with others.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen to practice creating a safe and honest offer for the community.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: The Trust and Safety Checklist shows you how to create your own offers safely and reliably in Vitanaland. It guides you step by step through all the important rules.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you always know that your business is well protected and fair. This builds genuine trust with others and gives you peace of mind.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Go through this list briefly before you publish a new offer or service for others.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the checklist and look at the first steps for your safe business.

fields.short_description: Turn what you've learned into a sprint.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: This is how you turn new insights into real success. A seven-day sprint helps you implement a new idea with focus for one week.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Instead of just learning something new, you get straight into action. This brings you quick and measurable progress toward your goals.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Start a sprint as soon as you've discovered an exciting idea and want to test it in practice right away.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen to plan your very first seven-day sprint and get started right away.

fields.short_description: Turn what you've learned into a sprint.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The next step feature shows you exactly what you should do now. This turns your new knowledge into an active sprint right away.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't waste time wondering what comes next. This helps you stay focused and actually get things done.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use this recommendation whenever you're ready to get started right away.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the displayed action now to start your first sprint.

fields.short_description: Turn what you've learned into a sprint.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Here you determine exactly what you want to measure your sprint success by. It's your personal benchmark for the coming days.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This makes your progress clearly visible and tangible. It motivates you tremendously because you recognize every small step in the right direction immediately.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You use this feature right at the beginning of a sprint to make your goal measurable.
fields.explanation_try_this: Choose on the screen now what you want to measure your very first sprint by.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: You've successfully completed the introduction. Now My Journey begins, your daily companion for a healthy life.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You don't need a perfect plan for your health. A small daily routine helps you move forward step by step in a relaxed way.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Use My Journey every morning to start your day and find out what feels good for you today.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen to celebrate your completion and continue right away.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Full access unlocks all of Vitanaland for you while your current stage in My Journey stays active. Your Life Compass now gives Vitana the exact direction for your next 90 days.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: From now on, Vitana adapts to your real life goals. This makes every suggestion from the Autopilot absolutely personal and moves you forward a little bit every day.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: You reset your Life Compass whenever your focus changes and you want to pursue a new, powerful goal.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen to start your full access and set up your first Life Compass.

fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your next milestone shows you how your journey continues after you start. It's your personal goal in the app that you work toward step by step.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: This way you never lose track and stay motivated every day. You always know exactly which small step will help you next.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Look at your next milestone when you're thinking in the morning about what you want to focus on especially today.
fields.explanation_try_this: Tap the screen now to discover your very first new milestone for your continuing journey.

fields.short_description: Your journey begins here – step by step.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: The beginning of your longevity journey – no pressure, step by step.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You'll know right away how your journey works and how to get started.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Right now, as the very first step of your journey.
fields.explanation_try_this: Listen to Vitana and then start your first session.

fields.short_description: How your journey finds the right next steps for you.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: Your personal plan for long-term health.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You always know what your next step is – and why it matters.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: When you want to understand how your journey is structured.
fields.explanation_try_this: Take a look at your plan and note your next step.

fields.short_description: Start small, stay consistent – that's how your journey becomes real.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: A small, clear action that supports your health.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: Good intentions turn into real momentum.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: Today – your first step can be small.
fields.explanation_try_this: Choose a simple action: more water, a short walk, or going to bed earlier.

fields.short_description: Progress means staying consistent, not being perfect.
fields.explanation_what_it_is: This is how you see your sessions turn into real progress.
fields.explanation_user_benefit: You'll recognize that every session is part of something bigger.
fields.explanation_when_to_use: When you want to see how far you've already come.
fields.explanation_try_this: Complete this session and watch your progress grow.
